notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.6
notes.content:

If you haven't joined us yet, we are waiting for you![/p][p][/p][p]Even though we are quite a small tiny team, we are always in touch with the community, listening to your feedback and reports [i](if you've got any issue we are not aware of, please let us know, we want to help)[/i], and so we bring you today the last Patch Notes:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/1a30d7a6d96143472bb8dd27097ca238a583679f.png"][/img][/p][h3]Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Tasks achievement will progress for everyone in the party when one task is completed, instead of progressing only for the player who completes it [/p][/*][*][p]Fishing difficulty has been linked to the Health Behavior setting, so if Health Behavior is “No Damage Taken” or “Lots of HP Regen.”, it will be much easier; if it’s “Some HP regen.” (default), it will be a little bit easier; and the previous (original) difficulty will be linked to “No HP regen.”[/p][/*][*][p]Arcshine will not have a rain bonus to appear and the previous rain bonus will be applied always instead [/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p] Fixed ghost item in the Bank with certain swaps (thx @HaycheGee)[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed horses able to be called during a Boss battle (thx @DAS_leo) [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]ːtamaiː Let us know what you think about this patch! We're eager to read your feedback ːtamaiː[/p][p][/p][p][i]See you in Insule![/i]
[b][i]The EP Games Team[/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.5
notes.content:
Hey hey, Scouts! 

A bit over a month has passed by since the release of Oppidum, and players feedback is being great! ːsteamhappyː

Also, some community members have managed to get up and running a subreddit for the game. Ain't it cool? It's [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/OppidumGame/]r/OppidumGame[/url]. Thank you, u/logginlogan, for the effort and enthusiasm <3

Meanwhile, we've been helping the community get going on our [url=https://discord.gg/hp9XP23eze]Official Discord[/url], for example, creating some voice channels so you can match with other players and enjoy some runs together. At the moment, we are somewhat around 950 members, and [b]it would be awesome to reach to 1000[/b] to enter Server Discovery feature! If you haven't joined us yet, we are waiting for you! 

Finally, we've been working on all known issues to get them fixed asap [i](if you've got any issue we are not aware of, please let us know, we want to help)[/i], and so we bring you today the last Patch Notes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/3e5a65d7a495f46cce27466043b6ce6bb11230de.png[/img]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Polished camera movement smoothness with pitch
[/list][h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed black trees / rocks when gathering in a certain rare circumstance
[*] Fixed Depth of field was enabled when using the Telescope even if it was disabled in Settings
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

Hope your adventures keep going on and Insule gets the help it needs!

[i]See you in Insule![/i]
[i][b]The EP Games Team[/b][/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.3
notes.content:
Here we come again with interesting news!

In case you don't know yet, we've kept working hard listening and helping the community with problems and doubts about our game, Oppidum. (We invite you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/hp9XP23eze]Discord[/url] if you haven't yet!)

Some of the most common issues have been inventory space, fishing and doubts about certain items that were not clear how or where to obtain, so those are the things we tackled in this new patch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/ecf6be9090031eb47a032bfbcf12aa25238dfd65.png[/img]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased effect of “tired fish” when fishing: after 30 seconds of fishing, the fish starts moving slower and is easier to catch, this effect is what has been increased
[*] Added an accessible mode for Fishing, linked to the “Single-Press Controls” Setting
[*] Added two of the unlockable inventory slots to the beginning of the adventure, making the corresponding quests to unlock now just one slot instead of two upon their completion
[*] New dialogue lines to explain better some very FAQs about items
[/list][h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare error related to lag that could lead to an item appearing duplicated in bank and inventory, but it wasn’t really there
[/list]

We'll keep working to bring you the smoothest possible experience!
Your support is very much appreciated.

[i]See you in Insule![/i]
[i][b]The EP Games Team[/b][/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.2
notes.content:
At EP Games we don't stop: thanks to the awesome community that you are growing, mostly on our Discord, we've detected and fixed some little issues.

We've been able to help you in between patches to fix some of the problems that we could immediately fix due to being an online game, but that's also thanks to you, scouts, who have been actively helping us understand what was troubling you and letting us access your game to help you continue with the adventure without further issues.

You've been playing for long hours and enjoying the adventure Insule has for you, either solo, with friends or even both! (we know you are making good use of the three slots available!), but there was an achievement you couldn't get just yet: get ready, download the new patch and jump into action!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/9df51028bfb69d85a399292c81861294362f3b6d.png[/img]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved the video memory footprint
[*] Added a Visual hint for Treasure Finder in compass so it does not depend exclusively on audio hint
[*] Removing building or Moving building now allows to move / remove more buildings without need to enter the UI again until you cancel the action
[*] Added a bit of range to allow the camera get closer to the player
[*] Configurable zoom for gamepad (when using mouse, this can be changed anytime with the mouse wheel)
[/list][h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added 2 missing chests that were necessary for the Sharp Explorer achievement
[*] Fixed jump attack sticking the character between two enemies
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

We appreciate your support and hope you can keep enjoying Oppidum!

[i]See you in Insule![/i]
[i][b]The EP Games Team[/b][/i]

notes.title: Incoming patch with new world settings
notes.content:
It's been just one day after release, but at EP Games we never stop! We are committed to our communities and our players, and so:

[h2]First day small patches:[/h2]
During the first hours, many people played the game for looooong sessions in all platforms (not only Steam, but also PlayStation and Xbox). We received beautiful feedback, as well as specific and helpful reports of small bugs that [b]we fixed over the night[/b] ([i]we are based in Europe[/i]). A little group reported crashes opening the game or on the first screen, but [b]that was solved as well[/b].

[h2]So, what's next?[/h2]
Well, we keep working on [b]supporting[/b] our growing community, [b]listening[/b] to players' feedback and [b]fixing[/b] anything that arises.

Some of you got in touch with us to give feedback about how much travelling there's at the beginning, or how difficult it was for you to find some items. We developed Oppidum with a lot of options so [b]each player could exactly enjoy it as they pleased[/b]. Because of that, [u][b]in the following days[/b][/u] we are adding:
[h3]New world settings:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Show distance in the compass markers
[*] Unlimited use of Travelling Scrolls
[/list]
These options [b]won't be enabled by default[/b], but you will be able to change them from [b]World Settings[/b] so the game keeps adapting to your gameplay style.

Apart from that, we are also adding:
[h3]New video options:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Vibrance
[*] Brightness
[*] Bloom (on/off)
[*] Depth of Field (on/off)
[*] Hidden hotkey to disable UI (control + H)
[/list]
Thank you for your feedback and interest in seeing Oppidum growing.

See you in Insule [i](or [url=https://discord.gg/hp9XP23eze]Discord[/url])[/i]
[i][b]The EP Games Team[/b][/i]

notes.title: Dev Update #10 - 2024 wrapped up for Oppidum
notes.content:
[h1]Hey scouts![/h1]

We hope everything's looking festive wherever you are at the moment. If not, don't worry, we're bringing you plenty of reasons to celebrate.

Since we're closing another year, we thought it would be a good time to give you a little recap of everything we have accomplished in 2024 during the development of Oppidum. So jump in our time machine and let's get to it 👇

[h3]A big shoutout to our community 🤝[/h3]

Back in January we [b]got our Discord community together to have a private beta[/b] with our most loyal followers. We really enjoyed watching them play, learning their impressions and getting their feedback to improve upon a demo that was available during [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]. Thanks to all the feedback we received, [b]we were able to improve the game and get it to where it is today[/b].

It's really amazing for us to watch people that are excited to play Oppidum, who look forward to it. So we wouldn't want to miss our chance to send a [b]big shoutout to our [url=https://discord.gg/b5MhStZk9N]Discord community[/url][/b], always ready to offer their support, and give you a reminder to join and help our little family grow larger 💙

[h3]The living world of Oppidum 🌍[/h3]

[b]Oppidum takes place in an island called Insule[/b], blooming with magic and wildlife. So of course, it was only natural that we took our time to make it look and feel right.

We made sure to fill Insule with [b]important landmarks[/b], [b]interesting spots to explore[/b] and places you will visit either by chance, or [b]guided by the expansive story of the game[/b]. We want you to get familiar with this land, [b]from the Gusty Hill to the Wetlands of Murmurs[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/8688579f7fab50f1fe4b27e04d9764150b98b191.gif[/img]

However Insule is [b]not only a lush island, but a dangerous one as well[/b]. There are many perils waiting in your path for which you will have to be prepared. 

Around this time of the year (that is roughly April) [b]we finished programming and integrating the first version of every enemy in the game[/b], which was a huge milestone!

[b]Every enemy has their own special abilities or strategies needed[/b] to defeat them, so they will offer you a challenge and keep you on your toes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/4e606f578eeab25e9f614a7b9d2715247efda469.gif[/img]

Soon after, [b]we integrated the weather system[/b], to fully immerse you into the natural cycles of Insule. Personally, I [b]think this added a lot of ambience to Oppidum[/b], and we took the time to put a small video together showing you how this feels! 🌦️

[previewyoutube=tZAeKZyY6-Y;full]https://youtube.com/watch?v=tZAeKZyY6-Y[/previewyoutube]
And last but not least, Insule is more than its biomes and its dangers. [b]It's also its people![/b] NPCs started looking better than ever, and [b]showing their full range of personality[/b] after we implemented animations and let them interact with their surroundings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/3a84ae1d47bb375eba78bfec5c8d5f15872778b2.gif[/img]

[h3]Time to showcase our progress 📸[/h3]

Since the game was improving so much, we needed to do something about [b]how we presented it to the outside world[/b]. For example, the Steam store was looking a bit outdated. So we [b]jumped into the game[/b],[b] snapped a few pics[/b] and dressed it properly with some [b]new videos and screenshots[/b].

Here's how some of them compared:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/05203d245e35bb35b4569b3826844bbc19f675c0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/2119d5418d2633eea120ac3007b9e5c3bcb25278.png[/img]

And we couldn't have chosen a better time, since around this time, we got [b]featured in a couple of articles[/b] from some important media outlets like [url=https://www.pcgamer.com/games/survival-crafting/temtem-veterans-are-working-on-a-breath-of-the-wild-inspired-narrative-survival-game-for-1-4-players-set-to-arrive-later-this-year/][b]PC Gamer[/b][/url], IGN and 3DJuegos!

We were beyond excited about these articles which, among other things, [b]highlighted this extended gameplay video[/b] you can also watch on our Steam page.

[previewyoutube=zIbEWgEwJ1w;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]A plethora of new things for the game ✨[/h3]

At this point after Summer, we had a more than solid base, so it was [b]time to start polishing and adding every extra feature[/b] we still hadn't had the chance to put into the game. For full context, here's a small comparison showcasing a small part of the work we had done [b]from February 2023 to October 2024[/b].

[previewyoutube=RksXJEfwuDw;full][/previewyoutube]
We took this time to include [b]extra, but important features[/b], such as [b]fishing[/b], [b]horse-riding[/b], and [b]an improvement of our character customization[/b], aside from many other things we're keeping [b]hush hush for now[/b] 🤫

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/3952bdc3987cf0100dbf5419f0f0965559f190be.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/ef94fe8838267aa98b4abb4564dfb4fea6dc57d6.png[/img]

[h3]So what's next for 2025?[/h3]

Well... you'll have to keep an eye on us and see for yourself!

We're at a [b]polishing phase[/b],[b] integrating anything that's left[/b] and working hard on some [b]big marketing pushes[/b] until release. Speaking of which...

[b]Oppidum is set to be released during the first quarter of 2025[/b] 🥳 we will give some more definitive information in the future, once we're confident in a date, but we hope this gives you [b]something to look forward to in 2025[/b].

At this stage, [b]we need your help more than we ever did[/b]. If you enjoyed this little recap of 2024, [b]consider sharing it with friends, your favorite streamers, or post it to your socials[/b], so others can also get excited about our progress and join the family. They're more than welcome to[b] [url=https://discord.gg/b5MhStZk9N]join our Discord[/url] as well[/b]! In the meantime, we'll keep working on it and sharing our process with you 🍃

And as a final send-off for this update, we want to leave you with [b]a little tease of a new feature we’re working on[/b]. Any guesses on what this could be about? We think it will give you the opportunity to [i]exhibit [/i]your knack for discovery 😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/61fc9748518752af6de640b37b42ecdba628fe7b.png[/img]

From the EP Games team, [b]we wish you a really Happy New Year![/b] 🎇🎆

notes.title: Dev Update #9 - Approaching the finishing line
notes.content:
[h1]Hey scouts![/h1]

We present you with a most ceremonious "boo 👻" from us. Contrary to what the season would demand from us, we are NOT here to scare you. [b]We only bring the good stuff here[/b].

We're [b]approaching the finishing line of the development of Oppidum[/b]. Yes, it's real, it's happening! We haven't been exactly quiet about it, but it's time we gear up for the release, which is happening [b]sooner than you might think[/b]. While we still keep it shush for now, let's talk about a few things in the meantime.

[h3]So... what about a demo?[/h3]

Given the recent Next Fest, we want to address the topic of demos and why you haven't seen one in a while.

[b]Development on Oppidum is going really well[/b] and has been since we started. We're incredibly happy with how far we've come in roughly two years of work. We've found [b]a pace that works for us[/b], and we're pushing hard to maintain it so you can [b]play Oppidum as soon as possible[/b]. However, this also means that shifting our focus to anything else would likely disrupt that momentum.

Releasing a demo for an [b]open-world game[/b] like ours would require reallocating resources toward its development. We want to provide the [b]best experience possible[/b], and that means polishing everything in the demo, preparing to address any issues you encounter, and ensuring a smooth experience overall. In short, [b]we'd have to pause core development and focus entirely on a small section of Oppidum for the demo[/b]. On top of that, we're also considering how to select the best portion of the game to represent the full Oppidum experience.

Does this mean there will never be another demo or beta test? Absolutely not. [b]We're still exploring ways to let you try Oppidum in its current state[/b]. The game is already a delight for fans of survival, adventure, and story-rich experiences. We're still adding the final touches, since [b]Oppidum will have a full-release[/b]. For those of you who were worried about an early-access, you can stop worrying now!

Rest assured, [b]we're committed to finding solutions[/b]. We're beyond excited for you to play the game. In the meantime, here's a comparison showing [b]how Oppidum looked in early 2023 versus how it looks now[/b], so you can see what our development process has achieved. We hope you're as excited about it as we are.

[previewyoutube=RksXJEfwuDw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Less talk, more show[/h3]

I'll admit that was a really long wall of text, so let me compensate that, and show you a few bits of newly added stuff, so I can further prove my point for our working philosophy:

We've changed the [b]look of the water[/b]!
[previewyoutube=moLKau12kmc;full][/previewyoutube]
There's a [b]whole new swamp area[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/6485799aed9a169416de60123e4b35696a0cf2e0.png[/img]
We've [b]rehashed every hairstyle[/b] in the game and added the option to [b]choose two colors.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/a0a730bc12c7323e9eacbf4fa5312ea85ea5772d.png[/img]
Let's not forget [b]horses[/b]!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/ef94fe8838267aa98b4abb4564dfb4fea6dc57d6.png[/img]
[h3]How long until release?[/h3]

That's a great question, and we’re almost ready to answer it! In fact, [b]we’re working on an announcement [/b]that will give you the details, and we want to do it right, with plenty of fireworks.

So, if you haven’t already, now is the perfect time to [b]join[url=https://discord.gg/b5MhStZk9N] our Discord[/url], spread the word[/b] about the game, and [b]invite your friends[/b] to join the community!

In the meantime, we're gonna get right back at work. We once again want to thank you for your support, and for getting this far with us. We can't wait to share the world of Oppidum with all of you!

[b]See you soon![/b]

notes.title: Dev Update #8 - The most spoilery devlog so far
notes.content:
[h2]Hey scouts![/h2]

How have you been? We hope the past month treated you well and that you found time to enjoy it in your own way. Now, we're excited to share [b]some fresh updates[/b] on what we've been working on.

We're deep into the [b]advanced stages of development[/b], focusing on implementing the final features and mechanics, while also refining what's already in place. [b]This devlog is a bit more exclusive than usual[/b], offering a sneak peek into some things that aren't quite ready to fully reveal. But we wanted to give [b]our dedicated community[/b] a first look, as your ongoing support means the world to us. Let's dive in!

[h3]This is a bait title[/h3]
And I’m not entirely kidding! Reel in your excitement because today, we’re diving into [b]fishing[/b]! 🎣

We’ve been dangling the bait for months, and now we’re thrilled to announce that [b]fishing is officially part of the game![/b] The primary purpose of fishing will be to use your catches as ingredients for muffins that temporarily boost your stats. But that’s not all, as there are other uses you'll discover as you play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/3b3b0c5b97d6fd395b4cf7c7cbe744d7317c334c.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/28b735dcb942f20b3ed26f902ff34fd361d7cd78.png[/img]

There will be [b]different spots[/b] to cast your fishing rod, with [b]different types of fish[/b]. Not every rod will be useful for every spot, or every fish 😉

While we’re still fine-tuning the animations and effects, we wanted to give you a first look at the UI for the fishing minigame. In this clip I'm using the begginer's fishing rod, which is the first rod you'll obtain in the game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/3952bdc3987cf0100dbf5419f0f0965559f190be.gif[/img]

[h3]Wait... there are cinematics?! 🎞[/h3]
Bet you didn't see this one coming! Yeah, [b]Oppidum is going to have some cinematics[/b] to give you some context about what's going on in the game. For that, we've chosen some unique artstyle to evoke a narrated story, almost like a tale.

Shh, technically I'm not exactly allowed to show you the cinematic, but I might sneak in [b]a few seconds[/b] to give you something to look forward to.

Keep in mind that this is an [b]exclusive, early sneak peek for you[/b]. What you see is a work in progress, so it will differ from what will be in the final game. Take a look!

[previewyoutube=eqGvgznWyfk;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Challenging battles ahead[/h3]
A while ago, I shared some details about the [b]bosses you'll face in Oppidum[/b]. We've been hard at work on their encounters, making sure they'll be as memorable and epic as possible. I mentioned before that these battles will be challenging, and what's a challenge without a bit of spectacle, right?

Rest assured, we're pouring our efforts into the VFX for these enemies, ensuring [b]their fights will be unforgettable[/b]. Here you can see a small glimpse at the first boss you will face, with its effects already into place to ensure a menacing fight!

Be mindful that [b]this video spoils most of the battle against the first boss[/b], so watch at your own discretion!

[previewyoutube=ivvUIcEt-Ow;full][/previewyoutube]
Thanks for sticking with us through this update! [b]What are you most excited about?[/b] Whether it’s the new fishing mechanics, cinematic teasers, or epic boss battles, we’d love to hear your thoughts. [b][url=https://discord.gg/b5MhStZk9N]Join us on Discord[/url] or follow us on social media[/b] to share your excitement.

We’re getting closer and closer to the finish line, and the entire team is thrilled to see Oppidum coming together. We can’t wait for you to finally dive in and experience everything we’ve been working on. The anticipation is building, and soon enough, you’ll be able to explore it all firsthand.

[b]See you next time![/b]

notes.title: Dev Update #7 - New screenshots and media coverage
notes.content:
Hey scouts!

By the guardians, summer has finally hit us with all its strength, and we're longing to take a swim at Litore's beach. Who's joining us?

Another thing that comes with summer is usually a wardrobe update. Well, in our case we decided to go with a different kind of update, and [b]give our Steam page a fresh coat of paint[/b]. We also have some exciting news to share, so let me tell you all about it 👇

[h2]We updated our screenshots, and here's why![/h2]
One of the things we had been meaning to do for a while is to [b]update the screenshots on our Steam store[/b] to better show off how the game looks currently, much closer to what you'll see when it's released. The previous screenshots had been taken at a very early stage of the game's development, back when we launched the store around a year ago. 

We've tried to [b]keep the spirit[/b] of the previous screenshots, while also [b]introducing new stuff that we've been implementing[/b] into the game. I think we did a pretty good job!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/05203d245e35bb35b4569b3826844bbc19f675c0.png[/img]
Our first enemy screenshot looked cool and dynamic, but the effects, posture, and even some of the items were outdated. We decided to take the opportunity to [b]show a more exciting battle by implying higher stakes[/b]. We also know how important it is for the user to see [b]what the game actually looks like when you play it[/b], which is why we kept the interface. 

You might also notice some post-processing effects on the old pic, which are [b]not included in the new one[/b]. We added those manually for the placeholders, as we considered them for the final game, but we're still on the fence about it. Do you think we should still give it a try? 🤔

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/a837f4aeca7ecc9a30ae394c4afd6f1243cd1ff9.jpg[/img]
This is a funny one. [b]Multiplayer has always been one of the top features[/b] we wanted to define our game, so we implemented it pretty early on. However, at this point in the development, there wasn't much to do! We definitely wanted to let you know about the resource gathering in the game, but our new screenshot also lets you know what you can do with those resources.

You can see one player [b]chopping wood[/b], while the other [b]processes that wood at the lumber mill[/b]... also built with gathered resources! This was a neat chance to show off the buildable camp, different equipment, and other activities, like tending to your crops. 🌾

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/2119d5418d2633eea120ac3007b9e5c3bcb25278.png[/img]
[b]Narrative is a huge part of our game[/b], bigger than it usually is for most survival games, so including some dialogue and characters was essential. Obviously, a lot of quests and storylines are dependent on the features that are included in the game, so at the time we didn't have a lot to work with. This was probably the most placeholder-y image of the bunch.

The dialogue, the NPC, and even the camera angle as you see them there are not present in the current version of the game. We also thought it would be a good opportunity to introduce, arguably, the most important character aside from yourself, [b]our best boy Kay[/b], and give a small glimpse of the main quest and the places it will take you to. 🏰

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/f30dc14c8df9a8e951e46ef07beca683c68ee78a.png[/img]
Last but not least, in spite of the BIG CLUB and all of the spiky rocks, it's hard to deny that almost [b]any monster looks scarier at night[/b]. And you should be scared of them. It's a good moment to remind you that the game has a day and night cycle, displaying a more than appropriate enemy to haunt you in the dark. But also, it’s a very [b]good chance to show off the different enemy types you'll be facing in the game, their effects, animations, and even their attached mechanics[/b]. See the chest they’re defending? That's your reward if you manage to get past them. Good luck! 💪

There are even more new screenshots on the store, so do go over there and take a good look at them. We’d love to hear your opinion.

[h2]We got some media coverage![/h2]
Yesss, we're pretty excited about this! [b]We've been featured in a few articles from some big media outlets[/b]. Looks like Oppidum is getting some attention, and people are liking what they're seeing. [b][url=https://www.pcgamer.com/games/survival-crafting/temtem-veterans-are-working-on-a-breath-of-the-wild-inspired-narrative-survival-game-for-1-4-players-set-to-arrive-later-this-year/]PC Gamer[/url][/b] was the first article we noticed, followed by IGN and 3DJuegos! Not gonna lie, I'm loving this kind of attention and hoping that it will only snowball from here 😁

If you take a look at the articles, do tell us what you think about them. Little-known (not really) secret about the video game industry: getting attention is hard, and [b]you need to work hard for it[/b], so of course we're pumped about this. Here's hoping you get to see us featured again in the near future!

By the way, we’ve also included a [b]longer-than-usual gameplay video[/b] on our Steam page and YouTube channel, which we think might have helped make people notice us. In this video, we show a section of the game and how it feels to play it. Take a look!

[previewyoutube=zIbEWgEwJ1w;full][/previewyoutube]
That’s our dose of exciting stuff for today. I hope you join us in celebrating achievements like this, and keep giving us your support! 

See you for the next update!

notes.title: Dev Update #6 - Dynamic weather, NPC behaviours and scrolls
notes.content:
[h2]Hey scouts![/h2]

Does anyone else feel like summer is closing in? Just me? Temperatures are rising over here, and it looks like we're in need of something to keep ourselves comfy and hydrated. So let's talk about different ways in which [b]we're making the world of Oppidum more immersive[/b]. Here we go! 👇

[h3]Mind the weather[/h3]

I hope you're as excited as me about this. We've implemented a weather system into Oppidum! If you're one to enjoy nature as its fullest, then you will surely appreciate the atmosphere meteorological changes bring to the experience.

Of course, rain is the most obvious example 🌧 [b]There's a whole different ambience when rain pours over Insule[/b], as you get to enjoy its sights and sounds. There's more to it than a simple effect, however! [b]You will be able to tell the forecast[/b] for the following hours of the day straight from your UI:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/dcc0a28bbad1fb7e75c86f98272c4b186fa29b8f.png[/img]

What did you say? Ain't nobody have time for that? Don't worry, the rain still won't be able to catch you unprepared. If you notice the day getting gloomier out of a sudden, [b]you might want to look up[/b]! How do the clouds look? You'll be able to tell straight away if it's gonna start raining soon! No need to water your crops 🌽

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/607381ab8b5d2246f018d9392d47fd476fabdb7d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/d4f7ab4bee3f18c05fb711712d2d2d56f45f099b.png[/img]

And of course, no weather system is complete without some [b]intimidating stormy effects[/b]! But don't take my word for it, and have a look instead at this video we've prepared [b]showcasing some of the weather effects of Oppidum[/b]:

[previewyoutube=tZAeKZyY6-Y;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]When the storm clears up[/h3]

But calm comes after the storm, and we want to make sure you're not the only one [b]enjoying a clear sky after the tempest[/b]. As you can see in the video above, inhabitants of Insule now will occasionally stretch their legs and take a stroll! No more standing in the same spot (unless that's actually their job, I guess!)

[b]Other characters will behave in more natural ways than before[/b], interacting with their surrounding, changing places, or maybe just finding the best possible spot to dig a good hole without ruining the lawn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/bbb460e54ae662b9684df4e56e143a5c08701e73.gif[/img]

[h3]Let's get back home[/h3]

And to do so, we're gonna close up the devlog with some [b]new cool mechanic[/b] that will make your life much easier. See this scroll? There are [b]different types to discover on your adventure[/b], but let's focus on this one for a moment. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/ce1bfd4abf893270a6f3039ab6027d2048fb6f38.png[/img]

Just [b]use it from your inventory[/b] and...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/2d8aa73545ea5bf5bc979c10fbae96845854303b.gif[/img]

Yup! This scroll will instantly [b]return you to your camp[/b], so whether your sleepy, need to drop a few items on your storage or need to craft a new sword to fight some foes, this will make the process much easier. I'm gonna let you guess what other types of scrolls you might encounter 📜

[h3]See you next time![/h3]

Thanks once again for sticking with me until the end. How does the weather system look? [b]You can [url=https://discord.com/invite/b5MhStZk9N]join us on Discord[/url] or follow us on social media[/b] to let us know your thoughts about what you’ve seen today.

I’d also like to remind you that [b]Oppidum offers an experience that can be enjoyed either as a single player, or with some friends![/b] Do you have anyone in mind you would like to share it with? We’re more than happy to welcome anyone into the community and it helps us a great deal.

In any case, I hope you guys have a great rest of the week, and [b]see you for the next update![/b]

notes.title: Dev Update #5 - Creating a dangeours land
notes.content:
[h2]Good day scouts![/h2]

I hope your weapons and armor are ready to rock, because today's update comes filled with perils. Much like Oppidum since [b]some of our most recent updates[/b], which we're gonna discuss right away! 

[b]Arm up![/b] ⚔

[h3]Enemy integration[/h3]
This is a big threshold! The first version of every enemy has been coded into the game. [b]That means every foe that will be present during launch is ready to put on a fight[/b]. They can not only attack you, but they'll also use special abilities unique to each of them.

Turtles hide in their shells and charge at you. Nature Giants are able to heal themselves. Slimes divide into smaller versions as you defeat them, so they take a while to get taken care of. [b]And many more![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/4e606f578eeab25e9f614a7b9d2715247efda469.gif[/img]

[b]Not every enemy will behave the same way[/b], either. Wild goats are timid and flee when you get too close. Bats might surprise you as you explore caves, because that's what bats do! Any gamer knows that, right?

With that said, there's still work to do. Sound and visual effects are not ready for many of them yet. Oh, and many still need to be tested and adjusted to make sure they're[b] fun and challenging to play against[/b]. This is something we test ourselves during our weekly sessions!

[h3]Stronger, scarier foes[/h3]
As you will learn when you step into Insule for the first time, [b]the land has been corrupted[/b]. What corrupted it and how is something I'm not telling you about right now. What I CAN tell you about is that [b]this corruption has made Insule more dangerous than ever[/b].

Some of the most territorial inhabitants of Insule have become bolder and more aggressive. [b]Meet the Thudulks[/b], a tribe native to Insule with settlements all around the island. They're perfectly willing to block your path and attack on sight. They use arcane magic, and you will likely find yourself engaging in conflict with them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/ea9041a142a2f0807864c37fa480a1676d3fba30.png[/img]

But they're not the single most dangerous thing that can cross your path. Some weird [b]storms have been sighted throughout the island[/b]. These storms are followed by the appearance of strange, corrupted, and extremely aggressive beasts. Keep your wits about you, specially when you're travelling at night!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/3ee62b4bcf1b830cc9c87da45c88cf481c12a898.gif[/img]

[h3]Ok, I might have lied…[/h3]
Yeah, it's true; we've integrated every common enemy into the game. That's exactly where we make a distinction, because there's actually a few more enemies left that still need to be worked on. [b]I'm talking about the game's bosses[/b].

Obviously, they will be more [b]complex, challenging enemies that will require special conditions and strategies[/b]. They're their own different category, that's why I'm not counting them in with the rest. 

You'll have to wait a bit to see them, but if you follow us on Twitter, or if you are a part of [url=https://discord.gg/b5MhStZk9N]our Discord community[/url] you might have seen small glimpses of them recently 😏 (and if you don't, what are you waiting for!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/6722e3ca2f644101e8939251974de274ba1391b0.gif[/img]

[h3]That’s it for today![/h3]
Thanks for reading this far. What are you most excited about from today's update? [b]You can join us on Discord or follow us on social media to let us know[/b]. 

The development isn't over yet, and there are still [b]many cool features to be added or polished[/b]. Personally, I'm very excited about our new weather system. Perhaps you'll catch a glimpse of it not too far into the future 😉

[b]See you next time![/b]

notes.title: Dev Update #3 - Demo improvements and more
notes.content:
Hello adventurers! Greetings and on to our first devlog of the year! We've been hard at work for many different reasons, since 2024 promises to be a very Oppidum packed year! Hop in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/94bc139341efddace35a7cef36f7fb736f37e7d5.png[/img]

[h2]Steam Next Fest is coming![/h2]
If you've been following our post on Steam, our socials or are a member of our Discord community, then you already now that we've had our hands at a [b]demo version[/b] for Oppidum for a while. 

This demo is getting featured on [b]Steam Next Fest, from February 5th-12th[/b]. The first few hours of the game will be available for you to have a little taste, guiding you through part of the story. 

Even though this demo is fully enjoyable as a single player experience, Oppidum was made with multiplayer in mind, hence this demo also features multiplayer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/0ceb2c69ec6e5039aeed057796af7d22dbd3b605.png[/img]
Here are some things we've improved in the past weeks and added to this demo:
[list]
[*] Polished movement synchronization during multiplayer for a smoother experience.
[*] Character customization has grown in depth, adding new options for facial features and body types.
[*] We've incorporated a hunger system for fans of survival!
[*] Implemented new effects for the characters' death. Your teammates can now revive you when you're down.
[*] Improved ragdoll physics for enemies when hitting them.
[*] Updated the animations for losing health for better feedback.
[*] Fixed an issue when breaking tools while you were using them.
[*] Fixed an issue where crops would sometimes grow in the wrong order.
[*] Added a shortcut to unequip items from your inventory with a single button.
[*] Improved the animations for seathing and unseathing.
[*] Updated the music playing during the night, as well as at the player camp.
[*] You can now check the game controls in the UI and during the demo introduction.
[*] The grass now flattens much more when you sit on it. This helps with immersion when relaxing by the bonfire!
[*] Added several new SFX, and polished some others.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/020950dbdab43446a67d143f29ae353dd3b30ecc.png[/img]
It's worth mentioning too that we're still working on developing the game, and there are many features that were left out of this demo but will be present for the game's final release. So, if there's anything you're missing once the demo is out, take a look at this list. You might find it here ;)
[list]
[*] Your camp will have an animal farm (if you build it!). You can take care of your animals to get some goodies from them 🐑
[*] Love your tools, armor and weapons but they're so simple right? You'll be able to boost them with some perks.
[*] Fruit and veggies are delicious, but they're even better when you bake them into muffins. You'll be able to use your camp's kitchen to make some tasty muffins that will give you buffs for your adventure.
[*] There will be fishing in the game, useful for the aforementioned muffins. There's way too much water in the game for it to lack fish!
[*] For the most curious (or competitive) of you all, player statistics will be available for you to check how many enemies you've defeated, how many resources you've gathered, how much land you've explored, etc.
[*] Insule is vast, we know. And since the full game will be even bigger, with more accessible zones, you'll need a way to traverse it quickly. Expect horses as a mount to help you with this! 
[*] If you're still in a hurry in spite of your trusty steed, don't worry. Insule will provide with a quick way to return to some key locations by teleporting.
[*] Insule is quite sunny at the moment, but that won't always be the case. Expect weather effects to come to the island for release.
[*] Of course, we will give you the chance to re-map the game's controls, so you can play it as you prefer.
[*] Your inventory won't always be that tiny and your buildings won't always be level 1, worry not! The fluffy friends you'll meet in the game will help you... eventually...
[/list]

[h3] Our Community [/h3]
We also keep working on building a strong community around this game, so if you'd like to be part of it, make sure you know where to find us :)
[h3]- [url=https://discord.gg/b5MhStZk9N]Discord[/url]
- [url=https://twitter.com/PlayOppidum]Twitter[/url]
- [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@play.oppidum]TikTok[/url]
- [url=https://www.instagram.com/playoppidum/]Instagram[/url]
[/h3]

notes.title: Dev Update #2 - Settlement building, updated characters and new key art
notes.content:
Hi again! 👋

Wow, can't believe it's been one month since our last dev update. We certainly haven't been idle during this time, and have a ton of stuff to show. Gear up, let's cut to the chase and show you what's new in Oppidum! 👇

[h2]A NEW FACE FOR THE GAME 🎨[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/816444b1afc52cf3fb6ad81ced66ea26262fedd3.png[/img]
Let's start with something major. [b]Oppidum has a fresh, new key art![/b] Look at it, it's simply fantastic! Our illustrator really outdid himself with this one. If you've been following us on our social media you've probably been able to take a good look at it already. 

You can see four people (maybe yourself and three friends) up and ready to explore Insule. They seem to have reached their destination. What could that structure on the distance be? 👀 There's still a long journey to get there, though, and some dangers in the way.

[h2]BUILDING OUR SETTLEMENT SYSTEM ⛺[/h2]
So, we've mentioned a journey and dangers along the path. But what good is any journey if you don't have a place to actually return to? That's right, [b]we've made huge progress to the settlement building system![/b] This will be you and your friends' home base. At your settlement you will rest when you need to, build crafting stations to set up your gear, store your goodies as well as tend to your crops and animals. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/759858a164adb659bcb408b7a02979fb6ab0a341.gif[/img]

There will be plenty of time to spend on your settlement, if it fits your playstyle. Either crafting new gear for you and your squad mates, baking some treats to boost your abilities or upgrading your stations to reach even higher limits. Of course, you will have to acquire the blueprints needed to build and upgrade your stations by progressing in the story and exploring the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/423e460750f4e340c67e31a9068033ba7204d559.png[/img]

[h2]MEET THE CAST 🐰[/h2]
And now that we've mentioned the story and the world of Oppidum, let's jump to our next topic. We've already talked about Insule, the beautiful open scenario for our adventure, and some of its locations. On our previous dev update, we showed a glimpse at Litore, one of the main settlements in the island. Let's take a moment to talk about its villagers. They are part of a unique species native to the island, and not so long ago every one of them looked like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/487e78a6d3c23bae5bdcd6c2a9c78f3bd83f6ac7.png[/img]

Cute, but we can't have them all looking the same! [b]We've been hard at work revamping the key NPCs[/b], giving each of them a unique makeover that [b]truly reflects their personalities[/b]. From the sassy blacksmith to the patient librarian, you will meet a diverse cast of characters that will make the story feel truly alive as they guide you through it. Take a look at how gorgeous they look!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/aa416f95dbc5a75b151b8ed7e9f9501575f2d65a.png[/img]

What do you think? What's your favorite one? They will be present in the story, so you will get to meet them and choose. Can't wait for you to get to know them!

[h2]OUR FAMILY KEEPS GROWING 🤝[/h2]
[b]The Oppidum community is growing[/b], and we can't end this update without a shotout to the wonderful people that have already joined our Discord, who have been chatting and theorizing about what Oppidum has in store for all of you. It's wonderful to have the support of our future players, and we can't wait for the family to keep expanding.

As a thank you to our community, [b]we've held a giveaway for our users during the month of October[/b], with one of the most active members having won a copy of the game for launch day. We'd love to hold more contests like this one in the future if our community keeps growing, so be sure to [url=https://discord.gg/g9YU4F8EaY]join our Discord[/url] if you haven't already to make it happen!

[url=https://discord.gg/g9YU4F8EaY][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/487b99bdb144f79a6bb94d1e6b6bdc382acfd9d2.png[/img][/url]

[h2]EVEN MORE STUFF TO COME 🍃[/h2]
That will be almost all for today. Almost. Phew, ain't too bad for just one month, huh? We've also been making some other adjustments to the game, and progressed in some other really important aspects. For example, [b]the armor sets are almost ready[/b], and we can't wait to show them in full detail. Here's a quick peek at how some of them are looking currenty:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/8f74e13745043d99bc068d0d590ce0336191705a.gif[/img]

[b]Multiplayer functions are well advanced in development[/b] too, so it will be very soon when we can show you some examples of it in action. We've done a few in our social media videos before, but it will look even better next time you see it 😉 And obviously, let's nor forget about the[b] story and questlines that are being written[/b] and integrated into the game. We can't spoil too much of it, but look forward to them!

And that's all for now! Thank you so much for reading and for continuing to support the game. As always, remember that you can follow us on our socials to keep an eye on the development, interact with us and let us know what kind of stuff you enjoy more about Oppidum! Here's the list at your disposal 👇
[list]
[*] Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/PlayOppidum]https://twitter.com/PlayOppidum[/url]
[*] Instagram: [url=https://www.instagram.com/playoppidum/]https://www.instagram.com/playoppidum/[/url]
[*] TikTok: [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@play.oppidum]https://www.tiktok.com/@play.oppidum[/url]
[*] YouTube: [url=https://www.youtube.com/EPGamesEU]https://www.youtube.com/EPGamesEU[/url]
[*] Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/g9YU4F8EaY]https://discord.gg/g9YU4F8EaY[/url]
[/list]

Have an amazing rest of the week, and see you next time!  
[b]EP Games 🌊[/b]

notes.title: Dev update - Combat, Environments and More
notes.content:
Hello there! 👋

Welcome to our very first developer update. Hope the beginning of fall has been treating you well 🍂 Oppidum has been really shaping up during these months since the release of the store, and we want to give you a rundown of some of the stuff we've been working on. Join us while we go through some of the biggest points we want to share with you 👇

[h2]TIME TO SHARPEN OUR COMBAT 🔪[/h2]
We've been working a lot on making combat [b]feel good[/b], while still being a[b] challenging experience[/b]. The 'feel good' part is easy to figure out but requires a lot of hard work and attention to detail. [b]Animations, VFX, sound effects[/b]... all add up to this. For example, have a look at this small comparison when parrying an enemy's attack. The previous version cancelled its animation when parried, while now it flows smoothly from one to another in a much smoother way:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/6e313817a3715aa264107d99ff61c94c04bd003e.gif[/img]

[b]Visual effects[/b] also play an important role in making the player feel each enemy's strike and distinguish them from each other. Here are some of the visual effects we've been working on:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/9f6fc52c6fa183500c622f3e8971f7ed9ac3aaa2.gif[/img]

Challenge will depend entirely on the [b]player's preference[/b]. We want to make the game accessible and give you the choice of whether you want it to be a difficult hurdle or a more chill experience. Ultimately, it will depend on how you decide to play. However, [b]different enemies will behave differently[/b], so if you decide to engage in combat, you will have to be ready to learn about their techniques.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/7fff8a3cbf1c7b91e577f9aa695d0836e72c5072.gif[/img]

[h2]ENVIRONMENTS ARE IN PLACE 🍃[/h2]
As you might already know, Oppidum is heavy on [b]storytelling and exploration[/b]. You're going to spend a lot of time wandering these lands in search of adventure, so they have to look great!

Take a look at one of the two main settlements of the game, [b]Litore[/b]: a nice and cozy coastal town that will play an important part after you arrive in Insule.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/dd06e66afe8479f02de42fbd845637ff73de0bd9.png[/img]

And speaking of Insule, we've also been working on making the island[b] lively and full of history[/b]. For anyone wondering about these landmarks, it should be clear that someone came before them. The isle is sprinkled with the remains of a civilization lost to time and memory:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/bec041aee73fffd7bf8710bf4916ac3bc4797121.png[/img]

And of course, don't forget that neither you nor the friends you will make are the only ones with a claim to these lands. Thudulks have camps all over Insule, and they are a source of [b]valuable loot as well as challenging battles[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/5b1f7b18378131354cc0b846898ae168caa29a09.png[/img]

[h2]AND MUCH MORE! ✨[/h2]
Aside from these grand visual additions to the game, we've also made sure that everything surrounding your gameplay will uphold to the same [b]standards of quality[/b]. We've worked hard on aspects of the game such as visual effects for items and resources, improvements to the light:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/02e461c71658264b746fe338ed97f6ddd018a98b.gif[/img]

Of course, not everything is 3D models and visual effects. We're particularly proud of [b]the icons our illustrator has prepared[/b] for every item in the game. This is how they will look in your inventory; take a look at some of them:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/f83325a6b7d6e8dd242ec2b07ed433bf0997124a.png[/img]

The story of the game is coming along nicely. It's a [b]quest-driven[/b] story that will make you progress through the game while you [b]explore the island and discover everything it has to offer[/b]. We can't wait to show you more about it!

Coming next, we're working on the [b]settlement building[/b] mechanics, which involve [b]crafting[/b] your own weapons and armors, [b]cooking[/b] delicious treats that will buff your character, and [b]farming[/b] and [b]fishing[/b] to gather those nutritious ingredients. We'll also keep working on [b]multiplayer[/b]. It's an essential part of the game, so we're determined to make it as good as it can be. [b]Look forward to future devlogs about this[/b]!

Remember that we have a bunch of [b]socials [/b]where you can follow our progress in smaller doses, for those of you who are impatient about the game and want to keep up with it. You can follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/PlayOppidum]Twitter[/url] (yeah, we're not calling it 'X' 😅), [url=https://www.instagram.com/playoppidum/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@EPGamesEU]YouTube[/url], and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@play.oppidum]TikTok[/url]. We also have a [url=https://discord.gg/g9YU4F8EaY]Discord server[/url] where we share stuff we won't show in public, listen to the community's feedback... and even give a chance at getting a copy of the game if you indulge us with your participation 👀 You're very welcome to join us there!

That will be all for today; see you next time! We wish you a very cozy season, and take care!

[b]Hugs from the fun people at EP Games![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/d174fdf47263110b183fa111b99fa2fa333767ba.gif[/img]

notes.title: We're launching our Oppidum Discord Server!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey, everyone![/h2]

First things first, we want to [b]wholeheartedly say thanks to everyone[/b] who has come to this page and wishlisted Oppidum! Thanks to those who haven't but will by the end of this update too! I'm sure there are a few of you as well.

In Oppidum, the community and the players (that's you!) are two of the most fundamental pillars for what we envision our game to be. When we came up with the idea for Oppidum, we always pictured a game [b]that could be played and enjoyed with friends[/b]—an adventure to share and be played in whatever ways you enjoy the most. So naturally, we would prepare a place for that community to hang out.

[h3][b]Introducing our Discord server![/b][/h3]
A place for you to discuss every new update on the game's development, catch some glimpses of the sneak peeks we will be sharing, and give us any feedback or suggestions about what you'd like to see in the game. We won't be able to fit everything into the game, but your ideas will be inspiring, and we're eager to hear them!

Of course, every major announcement about the game will be heard on Discord first. And yeah, there will be some exclusive rewards that you'll get the chance to win! We're working on some cool things on this topic; we're so excited for you to see them.

[b]Join us [url=https://discord.gg/b5MhStZk9N]here[/url]![/b] Hope you come check it out, and don't forget to say hi. We can't wait to meet you there!

[url=https://discord.gg/b5MhStZk9N][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/487b99bdb144f79a6bb94d1e6b6bdc382acfd9d2.png[/img][/url]
